options.B: Viral replication occurring in the presence of suboptimal drug levels
options.C: Taking too many medications from different classes simultaneously
options.D: Natural genetic immunity of the host cell

explanation: Drug resistance emerges when mutations occur during ongoing viral replication while drug levels are suboptimal due to poor adherence or interactions. [learn more](GNS215_U6_T13#GNS215_U6_T13_h6)

question: What is a primary purpose of birth preparedness and complication readiness during ANC?

options.A: To select the exact date and time of the baby's birth
options.B: To help families recognize danger signs and plan for emergency transportation
options.C: To determine the legal guardianship of the unborn child
options.D: To replace the need for physical examinations during labor

explanation: Birth preparedness guides women and their families on identifying danger signs, arranging transport, and preparing for emergencies before labor begins. [learn more](GNS226_U1_T003#GNS226_U1_T003_h3)

question: What is a direct benefit of high staff motivation and retention in primary healthcare facilities?

options.A: Increased staff turnover and frequent resignations
options.B: Lower quality of patient care and documentation errors
options.C: Increased job satisfaction and higher quality of patient care
options.D: Reduction in community health outreach programs

explanation: When staff are motivated and retained, job satisfaction increases, which directly translates to higher quality care for patients. [learn more](GNS124_U2_T4#GNS124_U2_T4_h6)
